# Field Requirements Analysis

## Digital Service Report Application

*A draft of this document was generated by Claude Sonnet 4.6 based on [this](https://github.com/TheRobotWhisperer/ServiceReportingFrontend/blob/192de1d306f085fbb31d1d08a2e7ce21bfa58dc1/app/types/Report.ts) file created by me. I made significant edits to that draft to produce the current document.*

*Phase 1 deliverable responding to: Identify Required Fields, Determine Dropdown Lists, Required Text Fields, and Mandatory vs Optional Fields.*

### Our Reference

| **Field** | **Input Type** | **Required** | **Notes / Open Questions** |
|---|---|---|---|
| Service Report Number | *Auto-Generated* | **Auto** | Auto-Generated; should it be editable? |
| TRW Contact | *Dropdown / Free Text* | **Mandatory** | Dropdown pros: Convenience. Dropdown cons: Non-trivial to add a new Contact |
| PO Number | *Auto-filled; Editable* | **Mandatory** | Auto-populated from Company field in Report Body; allow manual override |
| Billing Company | *Auto-filled; Editable* | **Mandatory** | Auto-populated; allow manual override |
| Address | *Auto-filled; Editable* | **Mandatory** | Auto-populated from Company; allow manual override |

---

### Report Body

| **Field** | **Input Type** | **Required** | **Notes / Open Questions** |
|---|---|---|---|
| Name | *Auto-generated* | **Auto** | Auto-generated; should it be editable? |
| Company | *Auto-generated* | **Auto** | Company is decided before entering the main Create Report screen (i.e. Click Create Report → Select Company → Fill remaining fields) |
| Contact Person 1 – Name | *Free Text* | **Mandatory** | |
| Contact Person 1 – Email | *Free Text* | **Conditional** | Requires one of Email or Phone |
| Contact Person 1 – Phone | *Phone Number Entry* | **Conditional** | Requires one of Email or Phone |
| Contact Person 2 – Name | *Free Text* | **Optional** | Secondary contact |
| Contact Person 2 – Email | *Free Text* | **Conditional** | If Contact 2 is present → require one of email or phone |
| Contact Person 2 – Phone | *Phone Number Entry* | **Conditional** | If Contact 2 is present → require one of email or phone |
| Service Detail | *Free Text (multi-line)* | **Temp Optional** | Bullet pointed description of work performed |

---

### Service Call Information

| **Field** | **Input Type** | **Required** | **Notes / Open Questions** |
|---|---|---|---|
| Purpose | *Free Text* | **Temp Optional** | |
| Date Reported | *Date Picker* | **Mandatory** | |
| System Down | *Toggle (Yes / No)* | **Mandatory** | |
| Status | *Dropdown* | **Mandatory** | Values: Open, Closed |

---

### Instrument Configuration

| **Field** | **Input Type** | **Required** | **Notes / Open Questions** |
|---|---|---|---|
| Manufacturer | *Dropdown / Free Text* | **Mandatory** | Would we prefer dropdown or free text here? |
| Model | *Dropdown / Free Text* | **Mandatory** | Would we prefer dropdown or free text here? |
| Serial Number | *Free Text* | **Mandatory** | Do Models have consistent serial number formats? Is it desirable to enforce them? |

---

### Service Dates *(Time Entries – one or more entries required on submission)*

| **Field** | **Input Type** | **Required** | **Notes / Open Questions** |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kind | *Dropdown* | **Mandatory** | Values: Travel, On-Site, Off-Site |
| Technician | *Dropdown / Free Text* | **Mandatory** | Dropdown Pros: Convenience. Dropdown Cons: Non-trivial to add new technicians |
| Start | *Date Time Picker* | **Mandatory** | Do we want to allow specifying date? |
| End | *Date Time Picker* | **Temp Optional** | Do we want to allow specifying date? |
| Break | *Time Picker* | **Optional** | How long was spent on break; must be shorter than the difference between Start and End |
| Description | *Free Text* | **Optional** | Per-entry notes / Included primarily to aid in creation of the Service Detail field |

---

## Open Questions for Review

1. **TRW Contact** – Should this be a managed dropdown (staff list) or free text? A dropdown reduces errors but requires maintenance.
2. **Instrument Serial Number** – Is there a known format or naming convention that could be validated on entry?
3. **Time Entry Technician** – Should technicians come from a managed staff list, or is free-text entry needed to accommodate contractors?
4. **Name** – What is the naming convention/format; should it be editable in the web view in case it is auto-generated incorrectly?
5. **Service Report Number** – Same question as #4.
6. Do we want to export the Service Dates – Description in the final report or just use it to author the Service Detail field? Are there any other fields we would want to exclude from the final export?
7. Final export will include total hours and total travel hours, and, if desired, a quote based on those values. These will be calculated as needed so there is no place to input them.
